title: Trump's tech allies reasserted their power in DC by lobbying the president to defy US intelligence agencies and pressure Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Trump's tech allies reasserted their power in DC by lobbying the president to defy US intelligence agencies and pressure Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO — Silicon Valley elites flexed their muscles in Washington to back Nvidia boss after humbling midterms defeat.
